source_resolution.reason: Reading the full PDF (retrieved byte-identical from the author's site, sha256_16 b65ba2b0399df6b0) shows the cited content does not exist: the notes have four chapters and no Section 5, and Section 2.5.5 is the restricted three-body problem, not a chain/string limit. The document cannot support any of the continuum-mechanics claims, so all thirteen displaced citations were replaced by verified treatments (Abeyaratne, Likharev, Stewart, Hunter, Barsukow) that were read at the cited sections.
source_resolution.search_summary: Searches on 2026-10-11 for Tong's continuum/deformable-body content returned only the author's own site and the DAMTP course page, both listing four chapters (Newtonian mechanics; Lagrangian formulation; rigid bodies with Section 3.7 'The Motion of Deformable Bodies'; Hamiltonian formulation) and no continuum chapter. Direct download and full-text extraction of the PDF confirmed the table of contents; an HTML mirror and the author's book expansion were checked for a continuum section without success.
